property_summary: For any caller and any distributor address, setRewardDistributor succeeds if and only if the caller is the contract owner (and then rewardDistributor equals that address); the mutant inverts the check, so calls by the owner revert and calls by non-owners succeed, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Invert the check in _checkOwner so onlyOwner functions revert for the owner and succeed for everyone else, allowing non-owners to call setRewardDistributor.
